attributes.text:
Thank you for choosing Documents To Go® from DataViz.

This application allows you to view, edit and create Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint files as well as view PDF files.

Additional features are also available through “In app purchases”. These features include:

• Opening and editing files from cloud services such as Google Drive, Dropbox, Box and OneDrive.
• Opening and editing files from your Windows computer using the Docs To Go™ Desktop Sync 
• Opening password protected files
• All paid features also include the removal of all ads in the app.
